comment: External identities for the EvoCFD baseline. The campaign runtime must
match these; a change here is an explicit baseline revision, not a silent
rsih_revision and pi_version are the known-good bootstrap verified on the
campaign host (all 102 RSI-Harness tests, typecheck, and build pass).
pi_version is pinned by RSI-Harness itself, not by EvoCFD.

execution_environment.host: air-gapped compute host, reached over ssh; no outbound registry access
comment: The host cannot pull from Docker Hub, so the image is built where the
network is reachable, exported as a tarball, and docker load'ed on the
host. Source trees are bind-mounted; the image holds only the toolchain.
